data.summary: The extraction is broadly supported for the core plan tiers and many headline limits, but there are actionable issues: product_name includes tier names despite a separate plan_name, electronics/valuables limits for Silver and Gold appear to conflate separate sub-limits, and several schema fields that call for activity lists and exclusions are materially incomplete or null despite clear PDF evidence.

findings.reason: The extracted product_name includes the Bare Essentials tier even though plan_name already captures the tier; the PDS product family is the cruise travel insurance PDS rather than a tier-specific product name.
findings.source_quote: Cruise Travel Insurance PRODUCT DISCLOSURE STATEMENT

findings.reason: The extracted product_name includes the Silver tier even though plan_name already captures the tier; the PDS product family is the cruise travel insurance PDS rather than a tier-specific product name.
findings.source_quote: Cruise Travel Insurance PRODUCT DISCLOSURE STATEMENT

findings.reason: The extracted product_name includes the Gold tier even though plan_name already captures the tier; the PDS product family is the cruise travel insurance PDS rather than a tier-specific product name.
findings.source_quote: Cruise Travel Insurance PRODUCT DISCLOSURE STATEMENT

findings.reason: The value says the $500 valuables limit includes personal electronics, but the benefits table has a separate personal electronics sub-limit row; the extraction does not capture that separate electronics sub-limit and may conflate distinct limits.
